post.message: LLM judge reported the PR title claims a fix that the changed non-test code does not plausibly exercise. Deterministic checks did not fire, but the judge's reading of intent vs. diff disagrees. Severity raised because the PR claims a fix ("Fixes #11029").
post.judgeRationale: judge refuted the block: The changed code plausibly affects the Lightning CSS code path, as the diff adds comprehensive Lightning CSS support including the `compileLightningCSS` function, `convertTargets` helper, and conditional logic that routes to Lightning CSS when `config.css?.transformer === 'lightningcss'`.
